item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be windy with a few showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen midweek next week, the weather will gradually become fine and very hot over the coast of southern China.

Date/Month: 18/06 (Saturday)
Wind: South force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
